sloka: नाहमौपयिकी भार्या परभार्या सती तव ।साधु धर्ममवेक्षस्व साधु साधुव्रतं चर ।। ५.१९.६।।।।
transliteration: nāhamaupayikī bhāryā parabhāryā satī tava ।sādhu dharmamavekṣasva sādhu sādhuvrataṁ cara ।। 5.19.6।।।।

translations.english: Her body looked colourful with dust. Although she deserved adornment, she had none. She was like a lotus stem in mud looking bright yet dull (with mud).
